LIVE EXTERNAL INTEGRATION AC — FEASIBILITY ANALYSIS (Cloud-mutation clause).
Dispatched Live External Integration run: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/32974681026 (workflow_dispatch on main).

Findings on the AC's literal 'fully exercise create/binding-lifecycle/commit-unknown/fuse against a LIVE Jira CLOUD instance':
- Live Jira DC lane (jira-dc-harness): ephemeral, isolated Dockerized Jira DC -> SAFE to fully mutate. tests/external/live_jira_dc exercises inbound+outbound create (with both provenance markers, create-and-bind), update/assign/label/link round-trips, and reconcile passes against real SDK/transport. This is the full mutating coordinator/create/binding-lifecycle exercise. SATISFIED for DC.
- Live Jira CLOUD lane (jira-cloud-s3-rehearsal): runs against the SHARED PRODUCTION Atlassian instance (projects REB + DIG). Mutation is forbidden by a documented cardinal safety rule and enforced 3 ways (structural autouse guard, read-only-by-construction code paths, before/after count oracle). There is NO ephemeral/sandbox Cloud instance analogous to the Dockerized DC, and no prior art for one. Provisioning a write-permitted sandbox Cloud project + granting the CI token create/delete on it requires Jira Cloud admin action outside this environment.
- commit-unknown recovery + provider/endpoint fuse are fault-injection behaviors that cannot be induced on demand against a HEALTHY live server (real network-partition-mid-commit / 3 consecutive real endpoint failures). They are validated end-to-end through the REAL coordinator via the portable credential-free verified-fake Cloud/DC suites (S5 T3), which drive real code paths.

CONCLUSION: the AC as authored is over-specified vs. what is physically/safely achievable — live Cloud MUTATION against shared prod is unsafe by design, and live fault-mode induction is not possible against a healthy server. The maximal HONEST live exercise = live DC full mutation + live Cloud real-transport read-only (multi-project fetch + dry-run preview over the S3 backend) + coordinator fault-modes via verified-fakes. Recommendation surfaced to operator before epic close.
